## MGIT Faculty Achieves Guinness World Record

News Date : 01 Dec 2024News ReportMahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT) is proud to announce thatMs. M. Varalakshmi, Assistant Professor, Department of Information Technology, has been recognized as part of aGuinness World Record (GWR)achievement.She contributed to the record titled:“The most videos of people playing a keyboard instrument uploaded to Instagram in one hour,”which reached an astounding1,046 videos.The record was officially achieved byMr. Augustine Dandingi VenugopalandHallel Music School, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India, on1st December 2024.MGIT congratulates Ms. M. Varalakshmi on this remarkable accomplishment and for bringing global recognition through her participation in this musical milestone.

Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT) is proud to announce thatMs. M. Varalakshmi, Assistant Professor, Department of Information Technology, has been recognized as part of aGuinness World Record (GWR)achievement.
She contributed to the record titled:“The most videos of people playing a keyboard instrument uploaded to Instagram in one hour,”which reached an astounding1,046 videos.
The record was officially achieved byMr. Augustine Dandingi VenugopalandHallel Music School, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India, on1st December 2024.
MGIT congratulates Ms. M. Varalakshmi on this remarkable accomplishment and for bringing global recognition through her participation in this musical milestone.
